owners.location_evidence: A unique 48-byte entry anchor and the complete high-register restore epilogue establish the same 0x206c-byte owner in every edition. Shared battle-unit offsets, affinity loops, effect dispatch, event calls, and cleanup establish its correspondence with GS1 EN owner 080bbb0c.

comparison_mask.method: Mask Thumb BL fields, words reached by PC-relative literal loads, and aligned in-owner ROM-address words.

candidate_validation.source_shape: target-first plan load order with shared state/command lifetime and GS2 inline-register-call route

twelve_rom_transfer_scan.method: Scan each of the twelve local ROMs by recursively bisecting it to 1 MiB leaves, with owner-length overlap at every split. Probes are complete .text bodies from adopted GS1 C objects with no relocation records. Every retained hit is unique in all twelve ROMs; candidate-show then independently linked and scored each transferred source against all six GS2 editions.
twelve_rom_transfer_scan.compiler_route: old-agbcc, inherited only for these byte-identical audio owners

compiler_family_probe.method: Compile the proved GS1 source with each locally approved compiler family, disassemble it and the GS2 owner, then measure exact mnemonic n-grams. This is a compiler-family diagnostic, not a claim that the GS1 source is exact GS2 source.

exact_shared_windows.method: Count unique even-aligned query windows appearing in the GS2 EN owner.

compiler_family_probe.register_evidence: The ROM owner allocates r7 to ordinary live values outside the save/restore sequence, including ldrb at 081207b6, multiply input at 08120afe, and a stack reload at 08122060. The former GS2 route passed -ffixed-r7, so that route could not emit this owner. GCC 3 without -ffixed-r7 restores the entry save pattern but remains much farther from the unchanged GS1 blocks than GCC 2.96.
compiler_family_probe.conclusion: The GCC 3 GS2 route is rejected for this owner. GS2 now remains a distinct target configuration while using the approved GCC 2.96 family; GCC 3 is retained only as diagnostic evidence until the broader GS2 corpus settles its scope.
